'''Oskus Stooratt''' was a [[Gender|male]] [[human]] who was present in the [[Takodana Castle|castle]] of [[Maz Kanata]] on [[Takodana]] when the [[First Order]] [[Battle of Takodana|attacked]] the [[planet]].<ref name="VII" />

==Behind the scenes==
Stooratt appeared in the [[2015]] film ''[[Star Wars: Episode VII The Force Awakens]]'',<ref name="VII" /> in which he was portrayed by [[Mick Fryer-Kelsey]].<ref name="Gazette Article">{{WebCite|url=https://www.gazette-news.co.uk/news/14153097.mick-fryer-kelsey-from-elmstead-market-wins-part-in-star-wars-episode-vii-the-force-awakens|text=Mick Fryer-Kelsey from Elmstead Market wins part in Star Wars Episode VII: The Force Awakens|author=Nugent, Chad|date=2015-12-18|work=Gazette Standard|archivedate=20200814124131}}</ref> He was only named in ''[[LEGO Star Wars: The Force Awakens]]'', which adapts the events of the movie in [[LEGO]] form.<ref name="LEGO">''[[LEGO Star Wars: The Force Awakens]]''</ref> Although the ''Star Wars''-themed [[LEGO]] games are own their unique universe,<ref name="Leland">{{Twitter|holocronkeeper|status/697867043870093312|[[Leland Chee]]|quote=@InevitablyBill @_drewski In the Holocron, I call it LEGO canon.|archivedate=20190722093006}}</ref> [[Pablo Hidalgo]] has confirmed that the names assigned to movie background characters are [[canon]]ical.<ref name="Pablo">{{Twitter|pablohidalgo|status/749616406245699584|[[Pablo Hidalgo]]|quote=@LelalMekha Yeah, same with Infinity.|nobackup=1}}</ref>

Fryer-Kelsey auditioned along with many of his friends for the film and though he was send a text message saying that he didn't get a role, he was later sent another explaining that the former message was erroneously sent to him and he was still being considered. He enjoyed his time filming Episode VII and is aware of his "immortalization" as a LEGO minifigure and this article on [[Wookieepedia]], for which he is very proud.<ref name="Fryer-Kelsey Interview">{{WebCite|url=http://www.starwarsinterviews.com/sequel-trilogy/episode-vii-the-force-awakens/mick-fryer-kelsey-oskus-stooratt|text=Mick Fryer-Kelsey (Oskus Stooratt)|archivedate=20170224113824|nolive=1}}</ref>
